title: Map every source row to its whole complement invocation and child input slot without expanding replicas
body:
## Result
Construct exact inverse row-to-complement-invocation/slot mapping by true job-rank bucket. With S_s fresh sources and replication a, x=b*S_s+j and divmod(x,B_(N-s)) pick the whole child call; s=N receives NoComplement.

## Novelty and predecessors
#4507/#5071 already give batch factors; this identifies individual source fields and handles cross-replica batches without expanding all occurrences.

## Verification
26 author flows, 1,334 replicated rows; independent 22 flows/3,900 rows/11 controls. Run python3 -I -W error -B research/source-complement-port-index/verify.py.

## Limits and kappa
Logical metadata, not physical gather/return or supplied smaller native programs. No new kappa; 0.00363005817 remains conditional.

## Credit
Prepared for @CubeJerry with substantial OpenAI assistance; credit predecessor authors and PRs as detailed in the package.

Full proof, reproducibility, negative controls and provenance: https://github.com/CubeJerry/integer-mult-bounds/tree/bd63147b1a193f68b5713e5814ac3b2c743beff8/research/source-complement-port-index
